name: ANSI/IEEE Substation form
aliases: IEEE Substation, In Service Or Unspecified
summary: IEEE-library form of substation: a substation representation identifies a documented facility boundary in a network or system diagram.
description: This reference locates substation in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented power stations family. A substation representation identifies a documented facility boundary in a network or system diagram. Its buses, transformers, switching devices and protection are developed on linked drawings. The public library uses HDV1_S00390 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Use the surrounding circuit labels and the project legend to identify the intended operating condition and connection. Carry the same device reference into the schedule or equipment document so the symbol can be reconciled with its real terminals, function and operating limits.

Read the internal electrical arrangement from the referenced substation SLD. A substation-type marker does not describe a complete switchgear lineup or GA footprint. The linked functional counterpart explains the same operating role in its own drawing context; agreement of every detailed convention mark is not asserted.
